models.forceStop.barrierReview: A model-load check still needs review in Models & services.
models.forceStop.eligibility: Only a process whose identity and ownership Forge can verify is eligible. Memory may take a moment to be released.
models.forceStop.interrupted: The affected render is marked interrupted. Review it in the render queue before continuing.
models.forceStop.progress: Forge is checking the service and verifying the stop. Keep this dialog open.
models.forceStop.renderSummary: Forge stops the {name} process that is running this render. This is the only stop that works while a render is busy: Stop service is unavailable until the render finishes.
models.forceStop.renderWarning: The render is marked interrupted and the queue pauses until you review it in the render queue. Partial output may remain in the project. Nothing is deleted, and model files stay on disk.
models.forceStop.stoppedBody: Forge stopped the verified process tree. GPU and system memory may take a moment to update.
models.forceStop.summary: Try Stop service first. Use force stop only if the normal stop does not work.
models.forceStop.unconfirmed: Forge did not confirm that the service stopped.
models.forceStop.unconfirmedHelp: The process may still be running. Check service status, the render queue, and Diagnostics before trying again.
models.forceStop.waitingNone: No renders are waiting for this engine.
models.forceStop.waitingRender: These stay in line after the stop. The queue pauses until the interrupted render is reviewed. A render that uses the interrupted render is cancelled only when you mark that one cancelled. Closing this dialog keeps all of them.
models.forceStop.waitingService: Force stop does not cancel these. They stay in line, and the queue waits for the interrupted render to be reviewed. Closing this dialog keeps all of them.
models.forceStop.waitingUnknown: Waiting renders could not be checked. Check again before deciding.
models.forceStop.warning: Active work may be lost. Forge will stop this service and its processes immediately. Any affected render will pause the queue for review. Model files and saved assets stay on disk.
models.memory.estimate: The required amount is a configured estimate, not a measurement. It is conservative and has not been calibrated for this computer, so it can refuse a render that would fit.
models.memory.gpuCovers: Live free GPU memory now covers the estimate. Retry to check whether the render can start.
models.memory.gpuNote: GPU free memory already accounts for loaded models and other GPU users. System memory is checked separately.
models.memory.gpuShort: Live free GPU memory is still below the estimate.
models.memory.hostFloor: The system-memory requirement is the configured safety floor. GPU memory is checked separately.
models.tooltip.check_memory_load_821109: Check available GPU memory and request that Stable Audio load.
models.tooltip.clear_after_checking_7c5e: Clear the queue barrier only after confirming the named model is not loading or waiting to load.
models.tooltip.clear_model_search_d3ab21: Remove the search text and show models matching the selected category.
models.tooltip.close_force_stop_dialog_d: Close this dialog without stopping the service.
models.tooltip.close_memory_dialog_cc7b4: Close this notice without changing any running service.
models.tooltip.file_size_d62906: Measured size of the model files Forge manages. Links are excluded, so disk space recovered may differ.
models.tooltip.filter_model_category_dde: Show all models or narrow the list to one category.
models.tooltip.force_stop_f7a9a1: Emergency stop for an unresponsive service. Active work may be interrupted; Forge must verify process ownership first.
models.tooltip.force_stop_service_120229: Immediately stop the verified service process tree. Active work may be lost, and GPU memory may take a moment to return.
models.tooltip.free_97a522: GPU memory available now. Forge checks this before loading supported models.
models.tooltip.free_now_dc848a: GPU memory currently available to load the requested model.
models.tooltip.gpu_memory_6cb741: Live GPU memory snapshot. Free memory can change when other apps load models or render work.
models.tooltip.hugging_face_read_token_d: Optional if access is already configured. Used by the local Stable Audio worker to access the gated model.
models.tooltip.location_5bc08d: Where the model files are stored. Files outside Forge-managed storage must be managed in their original app.
models.tooltip.measured_file_size_7323e0: Measured size of the installed model files. This may differ from the disk space recovered.
models.tooltip.model_folder_9912fb: Shows the combined size of model files Forge manages in models/. Other engines may store files elsewhere.
models.tooltip.models_and_services_using: Services that may be using GPU memory. Forge can stop an idle service it started; external services must be stopped in their own app.
models.tooltip.needed_bd2901: GPU memory budget and reserve configured for the requested model.
models.tooltip.not_enough_gpu_memory_bca: The reported free GPU memory is below this model’s configured budget and reserve.
models.tooltip.permanently_delete_model_: Permanently delete the managed model files. Project assets stay on disk; reinstall the model to use it again.
models.tooltip.remove_model_a973d1: Review the model location and size before removing its files.
models.tooltip.remove_model_files_b4058a: Review storage details and confirm whether these files can be removed.
models.tooltip.retry_memory_check_d6fc67: Check current GPU memory again and retry loading the model.
models.tooltip.retry_removal_43de24: Retry deleting the managed model files after a previous cleanup error.
models.tooltip.search_models_eae504: Find models by name or category.
models.tooltip.short_by_43a442: Estimated amount of additional free GPU memory needed before loading can proceed.
models.tooltip.start_connected_services_: Start the connected engines Forge can manage. This does not load their models into GPU memory.
models.tooltip.stop_selected_service_ret: Stop the selected idle service, then check GPU memory and retry the model load.
models.tooltip.stop_service_c806b6: Stop this service normally. Forge only offers this when it can safely stop the service; memory may take a moment to be released.
models.tooltip.total_aa59d0: Total GPU memory reported by the device.
models.tooltip.used_67cbd1: GPU memory currently in use across the GPU.
